reason: Decompose a Rust CLI for Proof #4 — the second half of the non-Python generalization claim (C3), with real constraints (C1): a hand-rolled CSV parser (quoted fields, escaped quotes, CRLF, positioned errors), a stats engine, describe/head subcommands, custom error handling with exit codes, and cargo unit+integration tests. 15 tasks across foundation/frontend/runtime/app/tests/docs, mirroring the Proof #3 pipeline shape exactly: proposal -> public SDK -> executor -> verification -> derive -> check. Std-only (no external crates) so the build is hermetic.

events.title: CSV parser with quoted fields and positioned errors
events.description: src/csv.rs: pub fn parse(input: &str) -> Result<Vec<Vec<String>>, RcliError>. Rules: comma-separated fields, double-quoted fields may contain commas, newlines are NOT allowed inside quoted fields (error), "" inside a quoted field is an escaped quote, CRLF and LF both accepted as row terminators, trailing newline optional, blank lines skipped. Track line and column for errors. Unclosed quote at end of input -> Parse error at its position.
acceptance: parse("a,b\nc,d") -> [[a,b],[c,d]]
quoted field with comma stays one field: "x,y"
escaped quotes: "say ""hi""" -> say "hi"
unclosed quote -> Parse error with line and column
CRLF input parses identically to LF

events.title: Per-column stats engine
events.description: src/stats.rs: pub struct ColumnStats { name: String, count: usize, numeric: usize, sum: Option<f64>, mean: Option<f64>, median: Option<f64>, min: Option<f64>, max: Option<f64> }. pub fn column_stats(rows: &[Vec<String>], col: usize) -> ColumnStats. count = non-empty cells; numeric fields parsed as f64 (trimmed); non-numeric cells excluded from sum/mean/median/min/max but counted in count; a column with no numeric cells -> all Option fields None. pub fn stats_all(rows: &[Vec<String>], header: &[String]) -> Vec<ColumnStats> (uses header names, or 'col N' when header shorter).
acceptance: column [1,2,3,4] -> count 4, sum 10, mean 2.5, median 2.5, min 1, max 4
column [1,x,3] -> count 3, numeric 2, mean 2
column [a,b] -> all numeric stats None
empty rows -> count 0, stats None

events.title: Describe subcommand logic
events.description: src/describe.rs: pub fn describe(rows: &[Vec<String>], header: &[String]) -> String. Output format (one line per column): 'name: rows=N non_empty=M type=numeric|string|mixed|empty'. type is numeric if every non-empty cell parses as f64, string if none parse, mixed otherwise, empty if no non-empty cells. Include a trailing summary line 'file: R data rows, C columns'.
acceptance: numeric column reports type=numeric
mixed column reports type=mixed
empty file reports 0 data rows
output is deterministic (stable ordering)

events.title: Head subcommand logic
events.description: src/head.rs: pub fn head(rows: &[Vec<String>], header: &[String], n: usize) -> String. Renders header + first n rows as re-quoted CSV (fields containing comma/quote/newline get quoted, quotes doubled). n=0 -> header only. n >= rows -> all rows. Negative n -> treat as 0. Trailing newline after last line.
acceptance: head with n=2 returns header + 2 rows
n=0 returns header only
n larger than row count returns all rows
re-quoting round-trips: re-parsing head output equals original prefix

events.title: Hand-rolled CLI argument parsing
events.description: src/cli.rs: pub enum Command { Stats(PathBuf), Describe(PathBuf), Head { path: PathBuf, n: usize } }. pub fn parse_args(args: &[String]) -> Result<Command, RcliError>. Accepts 'stats <file>', 'describe <file>', 'head <file> [-n N]' (default N=10). Unknown subcommand -> RcliError::Usage('unknown subcommand ...'), missing file arg -> Usage, '-n' without value -> Usage, negative/zero -n -> Usage. Also '--help'/'help' handled by main, not here.
acceptance: parse(['stats','f.csv']) -> Stats(f.csv)
parse(['head','f.csv','-n','2']) -> Head n=2
parse(['frobnicate','x']) -> Usage error
parse(['stats']) -> Usage error (missing path)

events.title: main.rs dispatch, error rendering, exit codes
events.description: src/main.rs: parse env args (skip argv[0]) via cli::parse_args; on Usage error print 'rcli: <msg>' to stderr plus 'try: rcli --help' and exit 2; on other errors print 'rcli: <msg>' to stderr and exit 1; success prints result to stdout and exits 0. Commands: read file (io error -> RcliError::Io), parse csv, dispatch to stats_all/describe/head and print. --help prints usage and exits 0. Stats output format: 'name: count=N sum=.. mean=.. median=.. min=.. max=..' with %.6g-style formatting (Rust '{}' on f64 is fine), n/a for None.
acceptance: rcli stats fixtures/numbers.csv prints expected per-column lines
missing file -> stderr 'rcli: ...' and exit 1
unknown subcommand -> exit 2 with usage hint
--help exits 0
